metadata.normalization: average-rank percentiles 0–100 among the same complete eligible Brussels neighbourhoods; income reversed; ties equal
metadata.income_definition: IBSA/Statbel indicator 2498: median equivalised after-tax income of residents, 2023. Household composition adjusted. Based on tax statistics and National Register; not administrative disposable income.
metadata.income_scope_limit: Tax-exempt income such as child allowances and social integration income is not included. Some international-employment and property/capital income is absent or underestimated. See IBSA Panorama 2025 pp.50–54 for the definition and its limitations.
metadata.income_comparability: Different definition from Amsterdam O&S IHHINK_MED (non-equivalised disposable household income). Each city is normalized and ranked separately; euros and scores must not be used as a cross-city income or performance comparison.
metadata.income_missing_note: 27 of 145 source rows contain a dash. Preserve as null. The Monitoring geography includes 118 residential neighbourhoods and 27 other areas; do not infer zero income or zero need.
metadata.green_method: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200; classes 10 tree cover + 30 grassland / observed non-water polygon pixels; deficit=100-green%; cos(latitude) row weights
metadata.heat_method: Median of finite band-1 summer LST pixels with band-2 valid_count>0 inside the polygon and non-water WorldCover mask; native 30 m raster
metadata.raster_membership: pixel-centre inclusion, all_touched=False; nearest-neighbour WorldCover thermal mask
metadata.coverage_note: Thresholds are analyst choices. Spatial coverage is not household coverage.
metadata.landsat_limit: Existing project composite JJA 2019–2023; original scene-selection/cloud-mask script is unavailable. Zonal extraction is reproducible from the supplied composite.
